summary: 修复总控真实 BiliDili Graph/Recipe Map 验收暴露的同一 ProjectContext continuation 链缺陷：Graph 不得向 Core 发送不存在或大小写失真的 modulePath；Recipe Map rollup 必须按 nodeId 唯一；continuation 必须在 inline-byte 裁剪之前保存完整 bounded 结果，使多页 union 无重复、无缺失，并让 terminal status/conservation/region.truncated 反映完整分页后的真实状态。保持 shared fact session、5/5 repo progressive coverage、opaque cursor、只读快照、120 秒 deadline、清理与零写入边界。不要修改 Core、Recipe 数据、检索排名或插件外仓库。
designIntent: Keep Core strict, reconcile Plugin module seeds to existing canonical source paths, dedupe rollups by stable node id, and paginate the complete bounded Recipe Map before applying per-page inline budgets.

required.verify: One clean AlembicPlugin commit only; report exact parent and changed files.

Focused RED/GREEN tests prove invalid module seeds are not emitted, root rollup is unique, and 3+ Recipe Map pages reconstruct the full bounded baseline exactly once; run relevant Graph/Map/session/schema tests plus build:check.

Run the BiliDili full-space source-path probe: Graph reaches 5/5 with no project-context-invalid-scope; Recipe Map shares factSessionRef and terminal multi-page union has zero duplicate/missing stable IDs.
BiliDili DB/WAL/SHM fingerprints remain unchanged and continuation artifacts clean after terminal consumption.
Review failure paths, status/conservation honesty, cursor confinement, and no Core/data/ranking scope drift.

targetTasks.summary: 合并修复 Graph invalid module seed、Recipe Map 重复 root rollup、pre-pagination budget 丢失三项真实验收缺陷，并返回一个 AlembicPlugin 提交与聚焦回归证据。
